mapper.select: select (select count(1) from wl_wx_user where del_flag = '0') as user_count, (select count(1) from wl_wx_user where del_flag = '0' and vip_expire_time > #{now}) as member_count, (select count(1) from wl_document where del_flag = '0') as document_count, (select count(1) from wl_document_unlock where del_flag = '0' and spent_points > 0) as paid_document_count

select date_format(u.unlock_time, '%Y-%m') as period_value, c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, count(1) as count_value from wl_document_unlock u inner join wl_document d on d.id = u.document_id inner join wl_category c on c.id = d.category_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.spent_points > 0 and u.unlock_time >= #{start} and u.unlock_time < #{end} and c.del_flag = '0' group by date_format(u.unlock_time, '%Y-%m'), c.id, c.name, c.sort_order order by period_value asc, c.sort_order asc, c.id asc

select date_format(unlock_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_value, count(1) as count_value from wl_document_unlock where del_flag = '0' and spent_points > 0 and unlock_time >= #{start} and unlock_time < #{end} group by date_format(unlock_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date_value asc

select date_format(active_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_value, count(1) as count_value from wl_wx_user_daily_active where del_flag = '0' and active_date >= #{startDate} and active_date < #{endDate} group by active_date order by active_date asc

select c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, count(d.id) as count_value from wl_category c left join wl_document d on d.category_id = c.id and d.del_flag = '0' where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.id, c.name, c.sort_order order by c.sort_order asc, c.id asc

select c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, count(1) as count_value from wl_document_send_record s inner join wl_document d on d.id = s.document_id inner join wl_category c on c.id = d.category_id where s.del_flag = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' group by c.id, c.name, c.sort_order having count(1) > 0 order by c.sort_order asc, c.id asc
